WOODWORK — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: WOODWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. International Cricket Team

2. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Overload every socket

3. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. Monitor
   C. CPU
   D. Keyboard

4. When learning Occupational Information, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Occupational Information.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Occupational Information.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Occupational Information.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Occupational Information.

5. When learning Upholstery, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Upholstery.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Upholstery.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Upholstery.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Upholstery.

6. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Run with the tool

7. When learning Estimation of Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Estimation of Materials.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Estimation of Materials.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Estimation of Materials.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Estimation of Materials.

8. When learning Emergency Management, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Emergency Management.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Emergency Management.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Emergency Management.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Emergency Management.

9. When learning Furniture Making, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Furniture Making.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Furniture Making.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Furniture Making.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Furniture Making.

10. When learning Design in Woodwork, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Design in Woodwork.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Design in Woodwork.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Design in Woodwork.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Design in Woodwork.

11. When learning Blending wood with other materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Blending wood with other materials.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Blending wood with other materials.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Blending wood with other materials.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Blending wood with other materials.

12. When learning Project Activity, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Project Activity.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project Activity.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Project Activity.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project Activity.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Estimation of Materials and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Occupational Information and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Emergency Management and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Entrepreneurship in Woodwork and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

====

2. C — Never touch live wires with wet hands

3. C — CPU

4. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Occupational Information.

5. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Upholstery.

6. A — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

7. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Estimation of Materials.

8. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Emergency Management.

9. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Furniture Making.

10. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Design in Woodwork.

12. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project Activity.
